sections.title: 1. N+1 Query Patterns — CLEAN
sections.content:
No critical N+1 patterns found. The `/api/cases` route uses `json_agg` with GROUP BY, and `/api/documents` fetches in a single query. The DB layer is well-structured.

---

sections.title: 2. React Re-renders — MEDIUM PRIORITY
3. Caching Opportunities — HIGH PRIORITY (easiest wins)
4. Memory Leaks — LOW-MEDIUM PRIORITY
5. Redundant Computations — MEDIUM PRIORITY
Recommended Action Order
sections.content:
| Priority | File | Fix | Effort |
|----------|------|-----|--------|
| **1** | `app/api/catalog/matters/route.ts` | Remove `force-dynamic`, add cache headers | 2 lines |
| **2** | `app/api/templates/states/route.ts` | Add `revalidate` + cache headers | 2 lines |
| **3** | `components/app/ChatInterface.js:371` | Wrap state handlers in `useCallback` | 30 min |
| **4** | `components/app/ChatInterface.js:75` | `useMemo` for `generateFactSignature` | 5 min |
| **5** | `components/app/EditorView.js:56` | `useMemo` for layout styles | 10 min |
| **6** | `CountyValidationInput.js:202`, `AffidavitForm.js:295` | Store timeout in ref, clear on unmount | 15 min |

Items 1–2 are pure configuration changes with zero risk and immediate CDN/browser cache benefits for every catalog/template API consumer.
